habitat: Subtropical/tropical moist lowland and montane forests
story: The Asian Emerald Cuckoo (Chrysococcyx maculatus) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Cuculidae family. It is most commonly observed in Subtropical/tropical moist lowland and montane forests, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Asian Emerald Cuckoo is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Asian Emerald Cuckoo into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
